# Navbar

**Status:** available. **Category:** navigation.

This repository's rules come first. Where this page disagrees with [Standards](../standards.md) or
[AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md), they win: no CDN, no npm, no images from other servers, no inline `style` or `onclick`.
Use the [macros](../../app/ui/templates/ui/macros.html) where one exists.

Use a navbar to show navigation at the top of the page.

[Navbar documentation](https://daisyui.com/components/navbar/)

## Class names
- component: `navbar`
- part: `navbar-start`, `navbar-center`, `navbar-end`

## Syntax
```html
<div class="navbar">{CONTENT}</div>
```

## Rules
- Use `navbar-start`, `navbar-center`, and `navbar-end` to put content in horizontal positions.
- Put the applicable content in each section.
- You can use `base-200` for the background color.
